policy: Task-relative child-agent dispatch. Roles own permissions; workloads and risk signals select capability, reasoning effort, and runtime request fields.

E.purpose: efficient directed work with closed semantics and bounded evidence

F.purpose: frontier broad, ambiguous, or high-risk work

profiles.purpose: exact lookup, fixed command, log filtering, or formatting
narrow research, structured summary, or deterministic mechanical change
confirmed bounded implementation or repetitive change with a deterministic oracle
ordinary exploration, implementation, failure classification, or clear multi-step work
complex causal depth, routine independent review, or bounded engineering trade-offs
cross-component, public-contract, migration, concurrency, FFI, security, or complex review
critical adversarial acceptance, irreversibility, or data-loss risk
explicitly acknowledged and evaluated exceptional work only

workloads.purpose: exact file, symbol, or call-site location
official documentation, version note, or API research
directed repository-wide impact or call-chain mapping
execute an exact command and preserve its first result
classify bounded logs, failures, or environment evidence
fully specified mechanical change with a deterministic oracle
confirmed bounded bug fix or feature slice with a deterministic oracle
multi-step work with a clear outcome and ordinary exploration
routine independent integration or adversarial review
high-risk security, data, compatibility, or rollback review
requirement semantics, dependency choice, architecture adjudication, or final claim

upgrade_rules.reason: causal, adversarial, or oracle judgment requires balanced capability and deeper reasoning
breadth alone needs balanced synthesis but does not require frontier judgment
open semantics, conflicting evidence, or consequential judgment requires frontier capability
critical engineering contracts require frontier capability and high checking depth
an open structured engineering contract requires frontier judgment until semantics, scope, and oracle are closed
critical acceptance or irreversibility requires explicit P6-class scrutiny
